note: Reviewed repository files that replace one verified baseline path each in the published carbonwebsite bundle. production-baseline.manifest.json still describes live; integrate-static.mjs --site-replacements applies these and verifies them after staging.

replacements.reason: Retires the /workbench/ page: its capabilities moved into the Pilot Designer (GOAL-WORKBENCH-16). The page tells visitors so, links to /ask-carbon/pilot-designer and redirects there after five seconds. The other workbench/ files stay published so saved drafts and bookmarks keep working.
